note: Hand-annotated action_type categories for the 53 dev sentences (devClassic 10 + devGroups 31 + scored 12) of span-labeler-corpus.json. The labeler manifest itself stays untouched (frozen data contract, sha unchanged) — this is a separate annotation layer consumed only by the classifier->extractor combo trial (run-combo-trial.mjs), which records this file's sha256. Annotated 2026-10-09.
criteria: action_type follows the parse task's definitions (run-task-trial.mjs PARSE_INSTRUCTION): item_use=使用物品做事 / npc_talk=与人物交谈 / move=前往地点 / inspect=查看物件 / other. Judgment calls, applied uniformly: (a) 用/使用+物品 -> item_use; bare tool-verbs implying an instrument (撬开) -> item_use; bare-hand actions on the environment (推开/擦亮/擦了擦/掀开/捅了捅/扳开/抵住) and tidying (摆正/折好收进/铺平) -> other; drawing a weapon without attacking (拔出短刃) -> other, same family as 拔剑攻击=other. (b) 递给人物 (斗笠递船娘/水瓢递守滩人) -> npc_talk: the labeler's rule 4 already treats these as npc actions (person -> TGT), so the category follows the span gold; ITEM is null for every npc sentence under the labeling rules, which is what the suppression rule assumes. (c) item-centric placement (挂在/扣在/盘在/系在) -> item_use. The scored twelve are exactly the classifier's 12 TEST_CASES (labels identical), which the classifier excludes from training — its predictions on them are clean generalization. Only 我去地下藏书室。 appears in classifier train data (move template slot); flagged at runtime from classifier-action-corpus.json, not here.
